messages:
jon: quick q — PR #5423 touches infra/runtime/config and models/serving/handler. CODEOWNERS lists /infra/* -> @eng-platform and /models/* -> @eng-runtime. both eng-platform owners (alex, lina) are OOO today. who is allowed to approve so we don't block tomorrow's release?

maria: if the rules require both teams' approval we shouldn't bypass. but for small config tweaks we've historically used the team-maintainers alias as an OK fallback. can you paste the CODEOWNERS snippet? :eyes:

sam: i vaguely remember adding @eng-platform-maintainers as a catch-all for low-risk infra changes. for cross-dir changes i'd still prefer at least one named owner to click approve. is this blocking release?

jon: yes it's blocking — release window is tomorrow AM. it's just switching a default flag, no migrations, no model changes beyond config.

lina: thanks for the ping — i'm technically OOO but can remote-approve from my phone in an emergency. if alex isn't around, i'm fine with maria/sam approving with runtime sign-off. please add a note in the PR saying who signed off and why.

maria: i'm okay to approve if someone from eng-runtime gives a quick +1. @derek can you eyeball the handler change?

derek: checked the diff — safe. no behavior changes to inference logic, just default TTL and log-level tweak. +1 from runtime. :+1:

release-bot: CI status — all checks passed for PR #5423. staging deploy scheduled for 03:00 UTC.

jon: great — maria i'll assign you as approver and add the runtime +1, and i'll cc @eng-platform-maintainers in the PR so we have the fallback recorded. adding the CODEOWNERS snippet here for reference:

```
/infra/    @eng-platform
/models/    @eng-runtime
*          @eng-platform-maintainers
```

jon: tagging final action items: (1) maria approves, (2) add runtime sign-off comment, (3) mark release note. thanks everyone! :pray:
